defects.screen: SCR-IN-01 (IN-01 danh sach phieu nhap + overlay IN-02/IN-03)
defects.viewport: 375x812 mobile (tai hien duoc o ca 768x1024 va 1280x900)
defects.reproduce: 1) Dang nhap vai nhan vien kho. 2) Vao /inventory roi sang /inbound de co lich su dieu huong. 3) Bam 'Tao phieu nhap' (hoac 'Scan' tren mot dong) de mo overlay. 4) Bam Back cua trinh duyet / nut Back cung tren Chrome Android.
defects.expected: Back dong overlay va giu nguoi dung o IN-01 kem bo loc dang dung. Annex D SCR-IN-01 coi IN-02/IN-03 la lop lam viec tren IN-01; NFR-SRS-006/NFR-SRS-021 bat buoc ho tro Chrome Android, noi Back la cu chi dieu huong chinh.
defects.actual: Overlay chi la state React (`draftOpen`, `scanDocumentId`) va deep-link `?screen=&id=` bi tieu thu ngay bang `setSearchParams(..., { replace: true })`, nen mo overlay khong tao history entry nao. Back roi han khoi /inbound; nguoi dung dang quet do mot phieu mat toan bo ngu canh va phai dieu huong lai tu dau.
defects.severity: P1 - Major (chan thao tac giua chung tren thiet bi bat buoc cua NFR-SRS-006, khong co duong vong)

defects.severity: P1 - Major (mat ngu canh giua luong co stock effect)

defects.screen: Hop dong API dung chung cho SCR-IN-01 / SCR-OUT-01 / SCR-INV-01 (khong phai mot man cu the)
defects.role: Moi vai goi endpoint co stock effect (inbound.scan/post, outbound.scan/post)
defects.viewport: Khong phu thuoc viewport (tang hop dong API)
defects.reproduce: 1) Goi POST /api/v1/inbound-documents/{id}/scan hai lan voi CUNG Idempotency-Key nhung payload khac nhau. 2) Doc error_code cua response 409. 3) Tra ma do trong docs/api-contract/HN-BE-API-002_ERROR_CODE_CATALOG.json.
defects.expected: Runtime tra 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (mot trong bon lop 409 bat buoc cua SRS §8.2) va catalog hop dong cong bo dung ma do o hang 409, de FE map duoc nhanh 'phai sinh Idempotency-Key moi'.
defects.actual: Runtime tra dung IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT nhung catalog KHONG co ma nay (247 ma, thieu dung mot trong bon lop 409). Generator chi nhan ma o dang literal canh HTTP status, trong khi ma nay di qua hai lop gian tiep: IdempotencyStore::CONFLICT_PAYLOAD_DIFFERS = ConflictCode::IDEMPOTENCY, roi gan vao bien trong switch ($status) { case 409: } cua ApiConventionMiddleware. FE doc hop dong se khong biet nhanh nay ton tai — dung nhanh quyet dinh cua duplicate/retry.
defects.severity: P1 - Major (hop dong cong bo lech runtime o nhanh dieu khien hanh vi retry cua client)
